name: Audit feedback

## Rating

How useful was the audit? (1 = not useful, 5 = very useful)

Rating:

## Findings that were useful

List issue IDs or rule names (for example `SEC-001`, `no-tests`) and why.

## Findings that were wrong or noisy

List issue IDs or rule names, the file and line, and what the code actually does. False positives become regression tests.

## Missed problems

Anything you expected the audit to catch and it did not.

## Context

- Harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, other) and version:
- Model:
- Plugin version:
- Mode (new design, full audit, quick audit):
- Repo size and main languages (no code needed):

Do not paste secrets or proprietary code. Issue IDs, rule names and a one-line description are enough.
